research.notes: Only the Business Scale-up and Productivity stream is recorded; the Regional Innovation Ecosystems stream gives non-repayable contributions to non-profits such as accelerators and post-secondary institutions, not to a business for itself. Structure: the business option funds "sole proprietorships partnerships social enterprises incorporated companies corporations or co-operatives Indigenous-owned businesses all other types of enterprises", and "It also funds non-profit organizations that offer services to businesses", so no structure answer is excluded and there is no structure rule. Location: the page says the program "creates the right conditions to start and grow businesses in Atlantic Canada", so every NL community meets it. Intake, amount and cost share are not on the page. The page says Indigenous youth, women and community-owned Indigenous businesses "could get extra support"; that is not an eligibility rule and is not modelled. Purposes are listed as a check-yourself item because "scale up and expand" and "find new markets" do not map mechanically to one purpose.
